request: Analyze GSE344550 for PMID 42679010 (Outbreaks of fluconazole-resistant Candida parapsilosis are driven by low-biofilm-producing isolates that emerge under host selection.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of primary human monocyte-derived macrophages infected ex vivo with C. parapsilosis isolates (GSE344550); fungal RNA-seq in GSE312575
final.primary_estimand: Macrophage transcriptional response to low-biofilm-producing (LBP: 29T, 49B) versus biofilm-producing (BP: 1T, 35B) C. parapsilosis isolates at 3 h and 24 h post-infection. No exercise, training, or physical-activity factor exists anywhere in the study.
final.sample_inclusion: macrophages from human donors infected with 4 isolates or uninfected; 30 libraries in GEO
planned_contrasts: BP vs LBP infected macrophages at 3 h (S4.13.p1, S2.7.p1)
BP vs LBP infected macrophages at 24 h (S4.13.p1, S2.7.p1)

paper_threshold.note: paper states only |log2FC| > 1; no p or FDR rule is stated

final.paper_method: edgeR on raw counts, TMM library normalization, low-expression filtering, ~ 0 + group:time; fgsea preranked on log2FC (S4.13.p1)
final.paper_results: DEG counts for macrophages are not stated in the text; results reported as GSEA (Fig 5, S4 Fig)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper (PMID 42679010) studies fluconazole-resistant Candida parapsilosis outbreak isolates, biofilm phenotypes, and host immune interaction. GSE344550 is the macrophage infection RNA-seq (FN.p1). Methods S4.13.p1 define the model ~0+group:time with BP vs LBP contrasts at 3 h and 24 h and |log2FC|>1. Nothing in the study concerns exercise.

checks: FN.p1 names GSE344550 as the macrophage RNA-seq
GEO organism Homo sapiens, cell type Macrophage, strains 1T/29T/35B/49B match S4.13.p1
contact Nobile Lab (UC Merced), consistent with the paper's authors

ownership.reasoning: Accession, sample annotations (strain, time) and the single supplementary matrix all match the paper's macrophage experiment.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns AM* equal the 'Library name' inside the GEO description field (inspect: 30/30). Strain and biofilm group (BP = 1T, 35B; LBP = 29T, 49B per S4.13.p1) come from the title; time from characteristics.

matrix.reasoning: File name 'counts_rpkm', GEO data_processing 'Supplementary files format and content: RPKM normalized transcripts', integer fraction 0.55 with fractional values (e.g. 1.63403). The paper used raw counts with edgeR (S4.13.p1); raw counts are not deposited, so edgeR could not be reproduced exactly.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the series contains only uninfected and C. parapsilosis-infected human macrophages (factors: fungal isolate biofilm group BP/LBP and hours post-infection). There is no exercise, training or physical-activity arm, so the requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identifiable. The paper's own BP-vs-LBP contrast is not an exercise comparison and is not manufactured as one.

candidates.value: bgrp LBP vs BP at 3 h / 24 h (paper's contrast)
candidates.reason_rejected: infection-isolate comparison, not exercise; out of scope for the request

design.reasoning: Request asks for exercise effects; paper (ABS.p1, S2.7.p1, S4.13.p1) and GEO metadata contain no exercise factor.

discrepancies.disposition: would block paper route; moot because case refused at design

discrepancies.data: uninfected controls exist at time 'Control' (3), '3 hour' (2) and '24 hour' (3); infected 3 h has 1T n=2, 35B n=2
